description: Schema for migrating a spreadsheet-style bankruptcy filing statistics PDF into a structured analytics table. Capture the complete set of filing count records and deterministic coverage-year scalars so independently extracted outputs can be compared field by field.

covered_year_end.description: The largest year value appearing in the printed 'year' column among all data rows in the table. Emit as a four-digit integer with no quotes, commas, or decimal point. Null is not allowed because the value is derived from printed year cells; ignore the header row when determining it.

covered_year_start.description: The smallest year value appearing in the printed 'year' column among all data rows in the table. Emit as a four-digit integer with no quotes, commas, or decimal point. Null is not allowed because the value is derived from printed year cells; ignore the header row when determining it.

filing_count_records.description: One item for each non-header data row in the main table whose columns are labeled 'year', 'chapter', 'district', and 'case_count'. Preserve the document's row order from the first data row through the final data row, continuing across page breaks; do not add rows for combinations that are not printed and do not include the header row.

case_count.description: The value in the 'case_count' column for this table row. Emit the printed count as an integer with no quotes, commas, or decimal point; if a thousands separator is visually present, remove it before emitting the integer. Null is not allowed because each included row must have a printed case-count cell, and a printed zero must be emitted as 0 rather than null.

chapter.description: The value in the 'chapter' column for this table row. Emit the printed bankruptcy chapter number as an integer with no quotes, commas, or decimal point; do not prefix it with the word 'Chapter'. Null is not allowed because each included row must have a printed chapter cell.

district.description: The value in the 'district' column for this table row. Emit the district code exactly as printed in the cell, preserving lowercase letters and any printed alphabetic suffix; collapse repeated internal whitespace to a single space if extraction introduces extra spacing. Null is not allowed because each included row must have a printed district cell.

year.description: The value in the 'year' column for this table row. Emit the printed four-digit year as an integer with no quotes, commas, or decimal point. Null is not allowed because each included row must have a printed year cell.

title: Bankruptcy Filing Statistics Data Export Schema
